facts.text: John is a shooting guard for the Minnesota Wolves, and the team's season opener is scheduled for next week.

evidence.quote: I'm a shooting guard for the team and our season opener is next week - so excited!
The Minnesota Wolves! I can't wait to play with them!

facts.text: John's goal during pre-season training is to improve his shooting percentage, which he has been working hard to achieve.

evidence.quote: My goal is to improve my shooting percentage. Been practicing hard and gonna make it happen.

facts.text: John mentioned that fitting into the new team's style of play was a challenge during pre-season training.

evidence.quote: Fitting into the new team's style of play was a challenge during pre-season.
